/*
* Word Addition
*/
inline word word_add(word x, word y, word* carry)
   {
#if defined(BOTAN_MP_USE_X86_32_ASM)
   asm(
      ADD_OR_SUBTRACT(ASM("adcl %[y],%[x]"))
      : [x]"=r"(x), [carry]"=r"(*carry)
      : "0"(x), [y]"rm"(y), "1"(*carry)
      : "cc");
   return x;

#elif defined(BOTAN_MP_USE_X86_64_ASM)

   asm(
      ADD_OR_SUBTRACT(ASM("adcq %[y],%[x]"))
      : [x]"=r"(x), [carry]"=r"(*carry)
      : "0"(x), [y]"rm"(y), "1"(*carry)
      : "cc");
   return x;

#else
   word z = x + y;
   word c1 = (z < x);
   z += *carry;
   *carry = c1 | (z < *carry);
   return z;
#endif
   }
